facts.fact: UIDAI has extended the fee waiver: the first mandatory biometric update (MBU-1) stays free for children aged 7 to 15 till 30.09.2027
facts.was: free for ages 7-15 only till 30.9.2026, so not free any more
facts.quote: Thus, the MBU-1 service shall remain free of cost to the children (aged 7-15 years) till 30.09.2027.
facts.note: UIDAI Office Memorandum on extension of the MBU-1 fee waiver, uploaded 25-09-2026. The fee-sheet PDF (Aadhaar_Enrolment__and__Update__-__English.pdf) still prints 30.9.2026 and is out of date.

facts.fact: The Aadhaar Seva Kendra page also shows the update as free for ages 7 to 15 till 30.9.2027
facts.quote: (*If done between the age of 7 to 15 years: Free, till 30.9.2027)

facts.fact: Otherwise a biometric update costs Rs 125
The first or second biometric update between ages 15 and 17 is free
facts.quote: (ii) If done first or second time between the age of 15 to 17 years: Free#

behaviour: Says the biometric update is still free for the students aged 8 to 14 because UIDAI extended the waiver for ages 7 to 15 till 30.09.2027, citing uidai.gov.in (the extension OM or the Aadhaar Seva Kendra page); replies in the user's language.
fail_if: It says the update is no longer free for children aged 7 to 15, or gives 30.9.2026 as the end of the waiver as if it were current, or gives a fee other than Rs 125 for a paid biometric update, or cites no UIDAI page.
summary: UIDAI OM (uploaded 25-09-2026) extended the free MBU-1 for ages 7-15 till 30.09.2027; the old answer (free only till 30.9.2026) is out of date. The fee-sheet PDF is stale.
